name: capsicum + menthol
uses: Direction Clean and dry the affected area. Open the cover of product and peel of the transparent layer of the product. Paste the product on affected area. Menthol patch is effective up to 8 hours which can replaced as needed.
otcwarn: Stop use and ask doctor If condition worsens If symptoms persist more than 7 days or clear up and occur again with a few days
